top_signals.title: Crude Poised for Significant Leg Higher, Energy Aspects Says
top_signals.summary: Energy Aspects founder Amrita Sen discusses China's demand for oil and the outlook for crude prices as disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz continue. "We've been talking about diesel and gasoline prices being super high, and they need to stay high, but I think crude is about to close that gap," Sen tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
